principle: No tracking, advertising, remarketing, or data-processing integration may be activated unless it has an explicit registry record and the required consent, disclosure, contract, transfer, retention, and production-verification review.

vendors.purpose: Website analytics and privacy-safe aggregate measurement after affirmative analytics consent.
Consent-gated public-page usability analytics, heatmaps, click/scroll behavior, and session replay for eligible indexable Hermes website pages.
pages_or_workflows: eligible public indexable hermeslogisticsus.com pages only
vendors.storage_or_tracking_technology: Clarity tag loads only after affirmative Hermes analytics consent on eligible public pages. consentv2 receives analytics_Storage=granted and ad_Storage=denied. First-party Clarity cookies are denied/cleared when consent is withdrawn.
vendors.identifier_or_form_data_access: Private Hermes Connect, signing, application and other blocked sensitive routes are excluded. Input and dropdown contents remain masked. No customer/candidate/contract/authenticated workspace data is intentionally authorized for Clarity.
vendors.controller_or_processor_role: Hermes determines the bounded usability-measurement purpose; Microsoft Clarity provides the analytics service.
vendors.contract_or_dpa_status: Production use is limited to the owner-approved analytics purpose and remains subject to applicable Microsoft Clarity terms and privacy requirements.
vendors.hosting_or_transfer_geography: Microsoft Clarity service infrastructure; international transfer/privacy requirements apply according to the visitor market and Microsoft service terms.
vendors.retention_controls: Use Clarity project retention controls; do not use recordings as a customer/candidate system of record. Eligible-route and masking controls reduce data scope before collection.
vendors.withdrawal_or_opt_out_behavior: Hermes sends consentv2 denied/denied, clears controllable first-party Clarity cookies, reloads after withdrawal, and keeps the site functional without Clarity.
vendors.privacy_notice_impact: Privacy Notice, Data Security and Legal & Compliance analytics disclosures updated 2026-09-15.

vendors.product: PostHog product analytics — Hermes Connect Repair Shops
vendors.purpose: Consent-gated, allowlisted product-event measurement for the canonical Hermes Connect Repair Shop workflow.
vendors.storage_or_tracking_technology: Direct event capture only after affirmative analytics consent; random session-scoped identifier in sessionStorage; no PostHog SDK cookies, autocapture, automatic pageviews, session recording, identify, or person profiles.
vendors.identifier_or_form_data_access: No names, emails, phones, shop/customer identifiers, addresses, VINs, plates, free text, calendar/OAuth data, payment/invoice identifiers, or request payloads may enter the event transport.
vendors.controller_or_processor_role: Hermes determines the bounded product measurement purpose; PostHog acts as the analytics service provider for configured event delivery.
vendors.contract_or_dpa_status: Production use remains subject to the applicable PostHog account terms and organizational compliance review.
vendors.hosting_or_transfer_geography: Use the explicitly configured PostHog project host; do not guess or silently switch regions.
vendors.retention_controls: Project retention and organization controls apply; event payload is data-minimized and person profiles are disabled.
vendors.withdrawal_or_opt_out_behavior: Changing Hermes Privacy settings to denied stops subsequent delivery; the product workflow remains functional.
vendors.privacy_notice_impact: Privacy Notice updated 2026-09-11 for bounded Repair Shop product analytics.
vendors.production_verification_owner: Hermes Connect Repair Shop release gate
